headerDisplay: Renson Healthbox 3 — exposes room air-quality sensors, ventilation rates, fan metrics, boost and profile control to HomeKit. Connects to the unit's **local API** (no cloud).

host.title: Healthbox Host
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Healthbox unit. Use this or healthBoxUri.

apiKey.title: Advanced API Key
apiKey.description: Renson local advanced API key. When set, the plugin activates it on startup to unlock electrical fan metrics (power, pressure, RPM, voltage).

requestTimeout.title: Request Timeout (seconds)
requestTimeout.description: HTTP timeout when calling the Healthbox.

enableBoostControl.title: Enable Boost Control
enableBoostControl.description: Expose Room boost as a controllable switch (use Non specific Global Boost settings below).

boostFanSpeed.title: Boost Fan Speed (%)
boostFanSpeed.description: Boost level sent when boost control is enabled.

roomBoostOverrides.title: Per-Room Boost Overrides
roomBoostOverrides.description: Override boost level and/or duration for specific rooms. Use the numeric room ID shown in Homebridge logs (e.g. 1, 2, 3…). Leave a field empty to fall back to the global setting.

room.title: Room ID
room.description: Numeric room ID from /v2/api/data/current (visible in Homebridge logs at startup).

boostLevel.title: Boost Fan Speed (%)
boostLevel.description: Override boost level for this room. Leave empty to use the global value.

boostDuration.title: Boost Duration (seconds)
boostDuration.description: Override boost duration for this room. Leave empty to use the global value.

enableProfileControl.title: Enable Profile Control
enableProfileControl.description: Expose a fan accessory per room to switch the ventilation profile: eco (33%), health (67%), intense (100%).

disableLogging.title: Disable Logging
disableLogging.description: Silence info/debug messages. Warnings and errors are always shown.

mqttEnabled.title: Enable MQTT
mqttEnabled.description: Publish all Healthbox sensor data to a local MQTT broker after each refresh.

mqttBroker.title: MQTT Broker URL
mqttBroker.description: URL of your MQTT broker (e.g. mqtt://127.0.0.1:1883).

mqttTopicPrefix.title: MQTT Topic Prefix
mqttTopicPrefix.description: Root topic prefix. All messages will be published under this prefix.

airQualityScale.title: Air quality scale
airQualityScale.description: Use the scale documented for your device. Unknown exposes only the raw index; index uses a continuous 0–100 scale, categories uses 1 (excellent) to 5 (poor).
